metadata.title: Ordinance on Medicinal Products (Medicinal Products Ordinance, MPO / Arzneimittelverordnung, VAM) of 21 September 2018, SR 812.212.21
metadata.edition: SR 812.212.21 · Arts. 61–66 (reporting obligations), Art. 62a, Art. 90, Annex 3 · Stand 1 January 2026, German text read on the Lexaris mirror (fedlex needs JavaScript); also Stand 1 April 2020 (WIPO Lex)
metadata.legal_basis: SR 812.212.21 · Arts. 61–66 (reporting obligations), Art. 62a, Art. 90, Annex 3 as in force; the official text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
